description:
Variation of
conditions 2 (Approved Plans) and 5 (Window in first floor flank elevation) attached to planning permission P/3310/21 dated 30/09/2021 to allow  Alterations to fenestration to side elevations, New boundary fences to side, Installation of CCTV, Amended driveway design, Installation of drainage channels and amended landscaping
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General
Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and
re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s),
other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank
elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission
in writing of the local planning authority.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">The window(s) in the flank elevation(s) of the
proposed development shall:<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of
1.7m above finished floor level,<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">&nbsp;and shall
thereafter be retained in that form.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">The roof area of the
extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or
similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the
local planning authority.</span></p>
